summary: Six distinct operating sponsors qualified for closed single-asset Industrial acquisitions in Columbus between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31, each with $5–15M transaction sizes and a current CFO/Head of Acquisitions contact verified since 2026-03-01. Several records were excluded for being brokers/managers, announced bids, portfolio totals, out-of-scope market/asset, sub‑$5M size, outdated verification, former employment, or post‑cutoff publication. A property SPV (R2141) was resolved to its operating parent (CYPRESS-SPO-90059) to avoid duplicate sponsor slots. Prospect CSV and comp‑grid XLSX were created with citations for the shortlisted records.
limitations: Contact_verified_at is taken from the provided extracts; the team-page update for R9956 changed the contact but did not separately timestamp verification of the new name.
The SPV-to-parent resolution relies on the executed ownership schedule provided; no independent cross-check beyond supplied sources was performed.
Later-dated update U-R4338-2 (effective 2026-09-10) was ignored per cutoff rules; if considered, it might change current employment status post-cutoff.
One sponsor (CYPRESS-SPO-90059) had multiple qualifying deals within the window; the most recent (via SPV R2141) was selected for ranking, which may differ from other consolidation approaches.
